convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorSchaffTriXTrendCycle indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position sizing and trade execution logic

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime for trade signal timestamps

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator

other_exits: BuyPosClose triggered when indicator color buffer [1] < 2 (downtrend signal), SellPosClose triggered when indicator color buffer [1] > 5 (uptrend signal)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lots, FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=fraction of available margin or balance. MM parameter (0.1) serves as either lot size or percentage depending on MMMode

custom_logic_notes: The EA reads buffer 1 (color index) of the custom indicator. Color values >5 indicate uptrend (green zone), values <2 indicate downtrend (red zone), and values 2-5 are neutral/transition. Buy signal: color[1]>5 AND color[0]<6 (staying in uptrend zone). Sell signal: color[1]<2 AND color[0]>1 (staying in downtrend zone). Signal bar defaults to 1 (previous bar). The LoadHistory() call ensures bar data is available. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose booleans gate which trade actions are allowed via input parameters. GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit suggests persistent state management for position tracking.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorSchaffTriXTrendCycle custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It is a Schaff Trend Cycle variant applied to Triple Exponential (TriX) values. The indicator uses two TriX periods (fast=23, slow=50) with a cycle period of 10, producing a bounded oscillator with color-coded trend zones (>5=up, <2=down). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar) must be reimplemented - these handle money management, new bar detection, and trade execution. The MarginMode enum supports 5 sizing modes that must be replicated. Position gate logic is delegated to TradeAlgorithms.mqh so the exact position-checking behavior (no_same_side vs no_opposite_side) is unknown without that source file - default to no_same_side assumption. SL/TP values (1000/2000) appear to be in points not pips - verify whether digit adjustment is needed at runtime.
